description: Ministry of Labour - Industrial Dispute between Mr. H. W. Sirinimal including 16 others and Amicc Exports Ltd. (E Only)
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the publication of an arbitration award related to an industrial dispute under the Industrial Disputes Act.
